hints.text: Rounding to the nearest tenth keeps one digit after the decimal point. The digit just to its right decides which way to go.
The tenths digit of $3.86$ is $8$ and the hundredths digit is $6$. Since $6$ is $5$ or more, the tenths digit goes up by one.
The $8$ tenths rounds up to $9$ tenths, so $3.86$ rounded to the nearest tenth is $3.9$.

explanation: The number $3.86$ lies between the tenths $3.8$ and $3.9$, so it must round to one of them.
Look at the hundredths digit, $6$. It is $5$ or more, so the number is closer to the higher tenth.
Round the tenths digit up from $8$ to $9$, which gives $3.86 \approx 3.9$.
